subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage accounting architecture as the long-term successor to the narrower v0.43.0 containment fix?
rationale: The patch is well tested and reversible, but accepting a parallel accounting engine, promotion authorization, cache identity, diagnostics, and long-term fallback is an architectural product decision rather than a remaining mechanical repair.

options.title: Sponsor the lineage stack
options.body: Review and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through this PR in order, preserving legacy authority until the promotion evidence is independently accepted.

options.title: Keep the shipped containment
options.body: Retain the narrower v0.43.0 mitigation and close or pause the lineage stack to avoid maintaining a second accounting architecture.

options.title: Request a narrower experiment
options.body: Keep only shadow diagnostics and performance seams in a smaller non-authoritative proposal, deferring selector and cache-authority changes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the lineage stack
recommendation.body: Review and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through this PR in order, preserving legacy authority until the promotion evidence is independently accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice determines the repository’s permanent scanner architecture and compatibility policy.
